WITH team_home_games AS (
    SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_home_games
    FROM home_game
    GROUP BY team_id
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_home_games) AS all_home_games,
           AVG(total_home_games) AS avg_home_games
    FROM team_home_games
)
SELECT t.team_id,
       t.total_home_games,
       t.total_home_games * 1.0 / totals.all_home_games AS share_of_all_home_games,
       t.total_home_games * 1.0 / totals.avg_home_games AS ratio_to_average
FROM team_home_games AS t
CROSS JOIN totals
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
